messages:
sofia: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: leadership wants a concise freeze/blackout policy + escalation matrix for Dedicated customers. Posting the notes here so we have a single thread.

anjali: I can draft the policy. Proposal: soft freeze = 10 business days before major launches (no non-essential UX/UX config changes), hard blackout = 72h before launch for infra changes and migrations. Security fixes are exception.

sam: sounds reasonable. Add a small clause for regressions: if top-5 regression rate > baseline during soft freeze, require sign-off from eng leads.

lee: I will create the engops doc at release-policies/freeze.md and link it from the all-hands notes. Plan to PR after we finalize wording.

rafa: For Dedicated escalation matrix, suggested flow:
1) Page primary oncall (10m ack)
2) If no ack or unresolved for 15m -> page infra SME (10m)
3) If still unresolved 30m -> page CS lead + exec oncall
Include a separate fast-path for Customer-Reported Sev1s (immediate bridge).

pm-zoe: PM ask: during soft freeze can we still ship API-only behavioral toggles (feature flags) for experiments? We need to know whats allowed so PMs can plan.

anjali: allow feature-flag flips only if they are server-side and non-migration. Add requirement: PM must file a freeze-exception form with risk assessment.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall rotation change on 2025-01-10 09:00 UTC. Weekly oncall sync tomorrow.

sofia: Action items recap:
- anjali: draft freeze/blackout policy and severity mapping (Due: 5 business days).
- lee: create engops doc + PR with pre-release checklist (Due: EOD Fri).
- sam: update postmortem policy for Sev1 (72h PM) and add Dedicated tagging requirement (Due: next Tue).
- rafa: draft Dedicated escalation YAML (contacts + escalation sequence) for automation (Due: 1 week).
- pm-zoe: circulate PM checklist examples for allowed changes during freeze.

sam: tiny implementation note: pre-release checklist should include a perf baseline export and a smoke p99 gate. If smoke_p99 > 1.2x baseline block the rollout.

sofia: Thanks all. I'll drop a short summary in #all-hands and link the engops PRs when they're up. If anyone wants to co-own the docs ping me.
